court: In the High Court of Madras†
respondents: State of Tamilnadu, Rep. by the Deputy Superintendent of Police and Others
advocates: For Respondents: Mr. A. Albert James Government Advocate (crl.side) for R 1 & R 2
prayer: Prayer: Criminal Original Petition is filed under Section 528 of BNSS Act, to direct the learned Special Court for trial of cases under SC/ST (POA) Act, Sivagangai District to consider the petitioner's bail application and dispose the same on the same day if the petitioner surrender before the learned Special Court for exclusive trial of cases under SC/ST (POA) Act, Sivagangai District in crime No. 125 of 2026 on the file of the 2nd respondent police.
judgment_text:
The Order of the Court was delivered by

R. Vijayakumar, J.:— The present petition has been filed by the accused person in crime No. 125 of 2026, on the file of the second respondent police seeking a direction as against the trial court to consider the bail application of the petitioner on the same day of surrender.

2. Considering the averments in the petition, there shall be a direction to the learned Special Court for trial of cases under SC/ST (POA) Act, Sivagangai District, to consider the bail application of the petitioner on the same day of surrender in crime No. 125 of 2026, after giving due opportunity to the defacto complainant.

3. The petitioner shall surrender before the concerned Court on or before 11-5-2026.

4. With the above said observations, this Criminal Original Petition stands allowed.
